shared_elements: carved stone surface with low-relief incised detail
human figure with distinguishable head, torso and arms
circular disc or rounded vessel-like form held/centred on the surface
horizontal band of repeated pattern across the lower area
justification: Both are stone works whose surfaces carry shallow incised relief, including a prominent circular disc form and a horizontal band of repeated ornament near the base, and both show anthropomorphic figures. But A is a massive, heavily eroded three-dimensional frontal figure with coarse, schematic markings, while B is a flat rectangular panel with two finely modelled figures in strict profile facing one another, so the compositional scheme and the level of carving finesse are quite unlike.
